archetypes.name: normalization-contract
archetypes.rationale: Parser output feeds multiple prompt surfaces, so byte-stable unmarked behavior matters.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the guideline parser changes for exact normalization behavior. Confirm marked entries emit only heading plus Mechanized line, and unmarked entries remain byte-stable. Check that G-Cfg-1 partial coverage is not overstated. Cite specific files, functions, and tests in your review. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
